limits: Runs packaged launchers on immutable development snapshots with private batch output bases and no shared action cache.
Eight ordinary unit cases run. Exported editor roots, features and macro bytes are authenticated; full analyzer diagnostics are qualified separately.
The exported project names temporary sandbox paths and is retained as evidence, not a persistent editor configuration.

Checks actual selected macro compiler actions, native scalar profiles and explicit target cfgs; complete compiler/default, native ABI/linker and arbitrary effective analyzer cfg equivalence remain separate.
Guest retains selected diagnostic identity parity and incomplete inference. Shared and quota require whole-model statistics and raw diagnostic parity with complete inference.

Quota exercises the packaged editor and test launchers in private batch output bases. Persistent editor lifecycle, other ordinary launcher enrollments, foreign targets, production cutover and performance acceptance remain separate.
